title: Strict mapping-cone model of relative Mayer--Vietoris
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes. Assume S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K∈D_QCoh(O_X), K′∈D_QCoh(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′. Let U,V cover X with U,V and U∩V quasi-compact. There are chain maps t:A→B and t':A'→B' and a strictly commutative square (α,β) between them. The six localized objects A,B,Cone(t),A',B',Cone(t') are isomorphic to the global, biproduct, and overlap relative source and target objects of def-pc-relative-mv-maps. Under these six isomorphisms Q(t), Q(t'), and the two cone inclusions are the specified first and second restriction maps. Q(α) is the specified global arrow, and Q(mappingCone.map t t' α β) is the specified overlap arrow. No short exact presentation on S' is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the pinned source and target Mayer--Vietoris distinguished triangles and their functorial morphism, with the displayed global, open, and overlap components.
Apply the generic endpoint cone presentation to the two distinguished triangles. Its cone comparison gives strict chain representatives and all six requested identities.

theorem relativeMV_cone_presentation
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let aX := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (A B A' B' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B')
      (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A ≅ aX.left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ aX.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).right),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map t ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr t) ≫ e₃.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map t' ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₁'.hom ≫ relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K' ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr t') ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₂'.hom ≫ relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K' ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ aX.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
